item: oo-on.js runs a name only for the event types the markup binds it to (audit A-023/A-024, stage 1)
refs: PR #1530; coordinator ruling 27 Oct; audit A-023, A-024; RELEASE_0.5_GATE.md section 1d
summary: EVENT_ACTIONS: a table derived from the markup (click 424 names, change 49, keydown 26, input 12, toggle 1; 512 pairs) consulted before GESTURE_ONLY. A name now runs only for an event type whose row lists it, and the 33 of 38 listened event types with no row run nothing: an injected data-on-error/load/toggle/focus/mouseover binding used to call any of the 480 allowlisted names with no click (the old gate test asserted deleteSource ran on error). Pinned both ways against the markup with zero slack (tests/test_oo_on_event_table.py, regenerate with python tests/test_oo_on_event_table.py), and every event type x name pair is walked through the real dispatcher in node (18,240). No behaviour change for any current binding. NOT solved, and stated: a change the browser fires after a script's el.click() is trusted (CLICK_IDS holds that chain); a person's click on injected markup is a trusted click on any click-row name; autofill/extension events not measured; the trust inversion that would delete GESTURE_ONLY (stage 2) is a 0.6 proposal.
